# mergeah_registered_user (Resource)

Manage a Registered User. Creation is idempotent by origin_user_id; import existing users to avoid taking ownership unintentionally.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
resource "mergeah_registered_user" "example" {
  origin_user_id   = "support-agent"
  origin_user_name = "Support agent"
  user_type        = "SYSTEM"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `origin_user_id` (String) Merge API field `origin_user_id`. Changes require replacement.
- `origin_user_name` (String) Merge API field `origin_user_name`.

### Optional

- `shared_credential_group` (Attributes) Merge API field `shared_credential_group`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shared_credential_group))
- `user_type` (String) Merge API field `user_type`. Defaults to `HUMAN`.

### Read-Only

- `authenticated_connectors` (Set of String) Value reported by Merge: `authenticated_connectors`.
- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier. See the Import section for its format.
- `is_test` (Boolean) Value reported by Merge: `is_test`.

<a id="nestedatt--shared_credential_group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shared_credential_group`

Optional:

- `custom_groupings` (Map of String) Custom credential-sharing groups.
- `origin_company_id` (String) Merge API field `origin_company_id`.
- `origin_company_name` (String) Merge API field `origin_company_name`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mergeah_registered_user.example '134e0111-0f67-44f6-98f0-597000290bb3'
```
